acts.title: Constitución Española
acts.note: Constitution of 1978: 169 articles, 4 additional, 9 transitional, 1 repealing and 1 final provision; 11 títulos, 11 capítulos, 2 secciones; royal formula ending with 'SABED'

acts.title: Constitución Española
acts.note: Current Constitution: the reforms (arts. 13.2, 135, 49) replaced articles without adding any

acts.title: Código Civil
acts.note: Civil Code of 1889, the oldest act in the BOE consolidated database: articles 1-1976, 13 transitional and 3 additional provisions; abbreviated block titles ('Art 1') and headings filed as provisions ('Sección segunda')

acts.title: Código Civil
acts.note: Current Civil Code: repealed runs grouped in one block ('Arts 301 a 324', 'Art. 1231 A 1253'), blocks replaced by later reforms (fecha_caducidad) left out

acts.title: Código Penal
acts.note: Criminal Code of 1995: 639 articles, 3 additional, 12 transitional, 1 repealing, 7 final provisions; the preamble comes from a correction of errors applying from the start

acts.title: Código Penal
acts.note: The Criminal Code in force on a past date, before the 2010 and 2015 reforms

acts.title: Código Penal
acts.note: Current Criminal Code: 'bis' to 'sexies' and 'quáter' articles, repealed runs ('Artículos 617 a 622'), expired chapter and section blocks

acts.title: Protección de Datos Personales
acts.note: Ley Orgánica 3/2018 as enacted: 97 articles, 22 additional, 6 transitional, 1 repealing, 16 final provisions; final provisions amend other acts ('Uno. Se añade ...: «...»')

acts.title: Protección de Datos Personales
acts.note: The same act requested by its ELI, in force on 1 January 2026 (two provisions added since 2018)

acts.title: Ley Orgánica 5/2015
acts.note: Amending organic law: articles primero (9 points) and segundo (5 points) amend the LECrim, tercero amends the LOPJ in one quoted paragraph

acts.title: Ley 39/2015
acts.note: Administrative procedure law: 133 articles, 9 additional, 5 transitional, 1 repealing, 7 final provisions; the third final provision amends Ley 36/2011 in 8 points

acts.title: Real Decreto 1720/2007
acts.note: Real Decreto approving a Reglamento printed after the signature (158 articles, its own provisions); the regulation's title opens a 'part' division

acts.title: Orden TMS/283/2019
acts.note: Ministerial order: 8 articles and 7 provisions, five annexes (ANEXO 1-5) with tables

acts.title: Real Decreto-ley 12/2026
acts.note: Recent Real Decreto-ley (May 2026): 3 articles, 2 additional and 4 final provisions; no royal formula

acts.title: Real Decreto 707/2026
acts.note: Real Decreto of September 2026 approving a Reglamento (21 articles in 4 chapters) that only applies from 2027; the consolidated version is refused until then

acts.title: Real Decreto 824/2026
acts.note: Act not (yet) in the consolidated database: parsed from the gazette XML; 'Uno.'/'Dos.' replace two annexes quoted in blockquotes with tables
